trace.constraint: 42B context cannot be fetched serially for every observed31clock DMA read;retain a read-critical cache/pending capture and prove arbitration deadlines. No new scheduler measured.

context_port_audit.required_work: Add host-clock context A port/owner arbiter and schedule SPI ingress vs SNES read/private completion;replace old states/registers/address muxes,not add a shadow. Charge fetch/store deadlines and CDC/fullMAP.
